children: Tractor Supply Company (
), the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the United States, will offer seven days of Black Friday savings Nov. 23-29 on Christmas gifts, décor, outdoor gear, pet favorites and winter essentials.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261119703411/en/
From tools and outdoor gear to pet supplies and winter necessities, Tractor Supply's seven days of Black Friday savings will offer limited-time deals across a wide assortment of products.

Customers can save up to 25% on Christmas décor and toys, up to 50% on apparel, up to $1,500 on recreation vehicles, up to $400 on safes and up to 30% on dog food, treats and toys. Friday-only, in-store doorbusters begin at 6 a.m. Nov. 27. Shoppers can also discover Tractor Supply’s distinctive farm-inspired holiday gifts and décor, including an exclusive six-foot Cowboy Santa Rooster, an animated Dancing Cowboy Santa and a Dynacraft Ride-On Highland Cow.

“Christmas at Tractor Supply is a little different. You can find a gift for the kids, something for the dog, a new tool for Dad and everything you need to get ready for winter, all in one trip,” said Seth Estep, executive vice president and chief merchandising officer at Tractor Supply.
Seven Days of Black Friday Savings
From tools and outdoor gear to pet supplies and winter necessities, customers can find something for everyone on their list while stocking up on what they need for the season ahead.
Nov. 23-29: Seven Days of Savings.
Black Friday pricing will be available across gifts, everyday essentials, outdoor gear and more.
Nov. 27: Black Friday Doorbusters.
Tractor Supply stores open at 6 a.m. with Friday-only, in-store doorbuster deals available while supplies last.
Friday-only Doorbusters
Customers can discover limited-time deals across a wide assortment of products, including:
Everyday essentials and seasonal favorites, including Tractor Supply buckets, winter beanies and cozy fleece blankets.
Pet supplies and accessories, including comfortable pet beds.
Tools and automotive equipment, including heavy-duty jack stands and garage jacks.
Outdoor recreation and sporting goods, including trail cameras, electric dirt bikes, gun safes and select ammunition.
Food preparation and homesteading essentials, including meat grinders.
Friday-only doorbusters will be available in stores while supplies last. Select styles and product availability may vary by location. Purchase limits and additional restrictions apply.
A Very Tractor Supply Christmas
Tractor Supply is bringing country flair to Christmas with a lineup of holiday decor perfect for those who live and love Life Out Here:
6-Foot Cowboy Santa Rooster: Standing six feet tall, this oversized Cowboy Santa Rooster makes a statement in any holiday display.
70-Inch Animated Dancing Cowboy Santa: With Western style and animated dance moves, this Cowboy Santa brings some extra personality to Christmas decorating.
Dynacraft Ride-On Highland Cow: A unique take on the classic ride-on toy, this battery-powered Highland cow makes an unexpected addition to children's Christmas wish lists.
44-Inch Light-Up Cowboy Gingerbread Man: This Tractor Supply-exclusive decoration puts a cowboy spin on a classic Christmas favorite with a light-up design
Black Friday Finds for Every Kind of Life Out Here

Customers overwhelmingly say the best gift is one they will actually use. Whether customers are checking off Christmas lists, gearing up for winter or planning their next outdoor adventure, Tractor Supply’s Black Friday event brings savings across the products its customers use, need and enjoy most.
Gifts for Kids:

Tractor Supply has plenty of unexpected finds for kids this Christmas, from Tractor Supply-exclusive Farm Friend Mystery Dolls to bigger wish-list gifts like the exclusive Dynacraft Ride-On Horse with Stable. LEGO is also new to Tractor Supply this Christmas, with sets ranging from a sunflower bouquet and playful puppy to a dump truck and front-end loader.
Christmas Décor and Entertaining:

The exclusive Red Shed collection puts a Tractor Supply spin on holiday decorating. For holiday entertaining and easy gifting, shoppers can also find the Tractor Supply Gourmet Kettle Corn Popcorn Bucket.
Gifts for Pets:
Four-legged family members can get in on the Christmas fun, too, with Black Friday savings across pet treats, toys and supplies for dogs, cats and animals of all kinds.
Outdoor & Recreation:

For hunters, outdoor enthusiasts and anyone whose Christmas list allows for more time outside, Tractor Supply will feature savings across recreation vehicles, safes, tools, apparel, trail cameras and other gear for outdoor projects and adventures.
Everyday Essentials:

Black Friday is also an opportunity to stock up on the products that keep homes, properties and animals running through winter. Savings span animal feed and food, shavings and bedding, livestock supplies, insulated outerwear, fencing and other everyday necessities for Life Out Here.

About Tractor Supply Company
For more than 85 years, Tractor Supply Company (

) has been passionate about serving the needs of recreational farmers, ranchers, homeowners, gardeners, pet enthusiasts and all those who enjoy living Life Out Here. Tractor Supply is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the U.S., ranking 290 on the Fortune 500. The Company’s more than 54,000 Team Members are known for delivering legendary service and helping customers pursue their passions, whether that means being closer to the land, taking care of animals or living a hands-on, DIY lifestyle. In store and online, Tractor Supply provides what customers need – anytime, anywhere, any way they choose at the low prices they deserve.

As part of the Company’s commitment to caring for animals of all kinds, Tractor Supply is proud to include Petsense by Tractor Supply, a pet specialty retailer, Allivet, a leading online pet and animal pharmacy, and VIP Petcare, the largest provider of mobile veterinary care in the United States, in its family of brands. Together, Tractor Supply is able to provide comprehensive solutions for pet care, livestock wellness and rural living, ensuring customers and their animals thrive. From its stores to the customer’s doorstep, Tractor Supply is here to serve and support Life Out Here.

As of September 26, 2026, the Company operated 2,486 Tractor Supply stores in 49 states and 135 Petsense by Tractor Supply stores in 21 states. For more information, visit www.tractorsupply.com and www.Petsense.com.
